transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Lee. Could you start by telling me what brings you in today?

Hi Dr. Lee. Um, well, mostly I'm here because I'm just incredibly tired. But it's... it's a kind of tired that sleep doesn't really fix. It's gotten to the point where even doing simple things, like unloading the dishwasher or trying to read for my certificate class, it just feels like too much.
How long have you been feeling this way—when did this constant tiredness first start?

Um, I'd say it's been about three months. This whole quiet, down stretch, where I just have really low interest in things and this heavy fatigue... yeah, it's been going on for about three months now.
Over these past three months, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, even when you have the energy or opportunity to do them?

Yeah, I have. I've pretty much stopped caring about the things that usually make me feel like myself. Like, I used to really enjoy sketching, or going to gallery openings. I liked cooking, doing yoga, or even just playing tennis with a friend. But lately, even if I have the time or a chance to do those things, I just don't have any interest in them at all.
Have you ever experienced a similar period of low mood, low interest, and fatigue like this before in the past, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

Um, no, this is the first time. I don't think I've ever felt quite like this before. Like, I've had days where I was tired or just in a bad mood, but nothing that lasted this long or felt this heavy. So, yeah, this is really the first time it's been like this.
Has anyone told you that you snore loudly, gasp, or seem to stop breathing for a moment while you're asleep?
No, I haven't heard anything like that. I mean, I live alone, so there's no one here to tell me if I snore or stop breathing, but... no, I haven't woken up gasping or anything like that.
Have you noticed any unintentional weight gain or weight loss over the past few months?

Yeah, I have lost some weight, actually. My appetite has just been kind of off. Like, sometimes I'll realize it's the end of the day and I've really only had coffee and maybe a few bites of food. I'm definitely not trying to lose weight, but my jeans have gotten a lot looser recently.
Have you noticed feeling unusually cold or having trouble tolerating cold temperatures compared to before?
No, not really. I mean, my temperature feels pretty normal. I get cold if it's actually cold out, but I haven't noticed feeling unusually cold or anything like that.
Have you noticed feeling lightheaded, dizzy, or short of breath, especially when standing up or exerting yourself?
No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I feel fine when I stand up, and I haven't been getting dizzy or short of breath or anything.
Have you noticed any new or worsening constipation over the past few months?
No, my digestion has been pretty normal. I haven't had any issues with constipation.
Have you noticed unusually heavy or prolonged menstrual periods recently?
No, everything has been normal there. I haven't noticed any changes with my periods, they've just been the same as always.
